pipelines.name: GenAI_Pipeline_on_CPU
pipelines.pipeline: {auto_source} ! decodebin force-sw-decoders=true ! tee name=split split. ! queue leaky=downstream max-size-buffers=1 ! videoconvert ! videorate drop-only=true ! video/x-raw,format=BGRA,framerate=1/1 ! gvagenai name=captioner device=CPU model-path="/home/pipeline-server/models/{parameters[captioner_model_name]}" generation-config="max_new_tokens={parameters[captioner_max_new_tokens]},num_beams=1,do_sample=false,repetition_penalty=1.1" scheduler-config="{parameters[captioner_scheduler_config]}" frame-rate=1 chunk-size=1 metrics=true ! gvametaconvert add-empty-results=true name=metaconvert ! gvametapublish name=destination ! fakesink sync=false split. ! queue leaky=downstream max-size-buffers=1 ! videoconvert ! videorate drop-only=true ! video/x-raw,format=NV12,framerate=30/1 ! appsink name=appsink sync=false

captioner-prompt.default: Describe what you see in the image in one sentence.

pipelines.name: GenAI_Pipeline_on_GPU
pipelines.pipeline: {auto_source} ! decodebin ! tee name=split split. ! queue leaky=downstream max-size-buffers=1 ! videoconvert ! videorate drop-only=true ! video/x-raw,format=BGRA,framerate=1/1 ! gvagenai name=captioner device=GPU model-path="/home/pipeline-server/models/{parameters[captioner_model_name]}" generation-config="max_new_tokens={parameters[captioner_max_new_tokens]},num_beams=1,do_sample=false,repetition_penalty=1.1" scheduler-config="{parameters[captioner_scheduler_config]}" model-cache-path="/tmp/ov_cache" frame-rate=1 chunk-size=1 metrics=true ! gvametaconvert add-empty-results=true name=metaconvert ! gvametapublish name=destination ! fakesink sync=false split. ! queue leaky=downstream max-size-buffers=1 ! videoconvert ! videorate drop-only=true ! video/x-raw,format=NV12,framerate=30/1 ! appsink name=appsink sync=false

captioner-prompt.default: Describe what you see in the image in one sentence.
